experimental_method: Isopiestic method at 155 C (stainless-steel autoclave, 12 vitreous-carbon cups: 3 MgCl2 reference and 9 test solutions, 48 h heating plus 48 h equilibration, mass loss by weighing) with MgCl2(aq) as reference; CaCl2 measured to test the apparatus, LiCl and CsCl as the target systems.
uncertainties_stated: Molality accuracy better than 0.2 percent; reference triplicates max deviation 0.10 percent (mean 0.04 percent); duplicate means 0.06 percent (CaCl2), 0.03 percent (LiCl), 0.17 percent (CsCl); temperature control precision 0.025 K; stock analyses +-0.07 percent.
quality_remarks: Authors adopt the Valyashko et al. MgCl2 compilation for the reference water activity; equilibrium molalities are given as the primary data so aw can be recomputed with a better reference. CsCl osmotic coefficients disagree with the Holmes-Mesmer extrapolation. Hydrolysis of MgCl2 checked by pH, none found. Temperature scale not stated.
